backward_compat_traps.rule: SMBus adds a 10 kHz minimum clock and clock-low timeouts.
backward_compat_traps.trap: An I2C device with no minimum clock or that stretches the clock past Ttimeout will be aborted on an SMBus.

backward_compat_traps.rule: PEC is optional; both ends must agree to use it.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Sending an unexpected PEC byte (or omitting an expected one) breaks the transaction byte count.

backward_compat_traps.rule: READ_VOUT/VOUT_COMMAND use ULINEAR16 whose exponent is in VOUT_MODE, NOT in the data word.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Decoding VOUT as LINEAR11 (exponent-in-word) gives a wrong voltage.

backward_compat_traps.rule: PAGE selects the active rail; subsequent commands apply to it until PAGE changes.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Forgetting to set PAGE reads/writes the wrong rail in a multi-rail device.

backward_compat_traps.rule: ARP can reassign a device's 7-bit address dynamically.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Assuming a fixed address on an ARP bus can target the wrong device after enumeration.

previous_versions: SMBus 1.0 (1995) / 2.0 (2000) — 100 kHz; protocol set, PEC, ARP, SMBALERT#, Host Notify, timeouts.
PMBus 1.0-1.2 — command language, LINEAR/DIRECT/VID, OPERATION/CONTROL, STATUS, PAGE.

key_changes.summary: 1 MHz high-speed mode, larger block transfers clarified, additional electrical options; protocol set, PEC, ARP, SMBALERT#, and timeouts carried forward.
Adds Zone Read/Write, additional commands, and AVSBus references; the command language, data formats, OPERATION/CONTROL, STATUS, and PAGE are unchanged.

fields.version_naming_history_note: SMBus is maintained by the System Management Interface Forum (SMIF); PMBus is an open standard layered on SMBus (PMBus Part I transport = SMBus; Part II = command language). Facts here are grounded in the public SMBus 3.x and PMBus 1.3 specifications.
